title: Yellow Delicate Saudi Arabian Egg Spring Rolls
description: A light and aerated Saudi Arabian dish featuring egg roll wrappers and a delicate egg filling, perfect for a snack or light meal. This recipe is low in fat and friendly to those with dietary restrictions.

ingredients.name: egg roll wrappers
ingredients.notes: found in the frozen food section

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Heat the vegetable oil in a small skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped scallions to the skillet and cook until softened, about 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked scallions, beaten eggs, and water, and mix until well combined.
Lay an egg roll wrapper on a flat surface and brush the edges with the sesame oil.
Place about 1 tablespoon of the egg mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Brush the edges of the wrapper with a little water, then fold the bottom half up over the filling, and fold in the sides and roll up the wrapper to form a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
Serve the spring rolls warm or at room temperature.
To serve, place the spring rolls on a serving platter and garnish with additional chopped scallions if desired.
